caption: The drawing consists of a stylized central flower with distinct, symmetrical petals surrounded by an arrangement of leaves and smaller flowers. The central flower has a prominent vertical composition, with three main elongated petals at the top—two on the sides colored in alternating red and blue with dotted borders, and one in the center colored in yellow. The core of the central flower is filled with yellow and brown lines, and below it are two large green leaves intersecting with twisting brown stems. Extending outward from the central stem, there are several red pointed shapes resembling additional petals or leaves, and among them are smaller blue flowers with curved petals and yellow-green leaves. The overall composition is balanced and vertically oriented, with the colors primarily consisting of shades of red, blue, yellow, green, and brown on a beige background. The drawing is constructed with clear, separated elements and has an underlying faint grid pattern across the paper.
title: Design from Proposed Portfolio
